title: Wren and the Machine
author: Mara Iversen
blurb: Vesper Halloran, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
